scope: Define and validate the first Flash-Next native-MTP training bank adapter without modifying the 27B DFlash2 trainer.

decision.existing_trainer: mlx_gptq.dflash2_distill is retained unchanged as the Qwen3.8-27B/DFlash2 trainer.
decision.reason: DFlash2 hard-codes five 5,120-wide draft layers, 25,600-wide target features, 46 LoRA modules, 47 QAT tensor pairs, and DFlash export names. Flash-Next has 48 hybrid GDN/QSA/PLE trunk layers, hidden size 2,560, a 10,240-wide four-stream residual, and an already-running one-layer native MTP cell.
decision.pairing: Source verifier residual row i plus input token at i+1; teacher full-vocabulary logits row i+1 predict position i+2. Using logits row i would train the wrong one-step target.

implementation.bank_reader: NativeMTPBank validates headed matrix byte lengths, sidecar columns, accepted-row bounds, unique round/row keys, contiguous positions, token ranges, prompt-final-plus-prior-argmax input chain, per-row finiteness, and per-row binary argmax agreement.
implementation.dataset: NativeMTPPairDataset lazily maps 512 accepted verifier rows to 511 two-ahead native-MTP training pairs.
implementation.manifest: write_training_manifest emits flashnext-native-mtp-bank-v1 with artifact hashes and pairing non-claims.

real_bank.loader_result: Every one of 511 pairs passed shape, finiteness, argmax, and source/teacher position checks.

checks.command: uv run --frozen ruff check mlx_gptq/flashnext_mtp.py tests/test_flashnext_mtp.py
uv run --frozen ruff format --check mlx_gptq/flashnext_mtp.py tests/test_flashnext_mtp.py
Real Strix bank loaded through NativeMTPPairDataset and every pair validated.

non_claims: No native MTP weights, LoRA adapters, QAT tensors, checkpoints, or runtime artifacts were trained or modified.
The loader proves data alignment only; it does not prove MTP forward parity or model quality.
The 512-row bank is a small private smoke substrate, not a representative training corpus.
